application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: TPO 3 T18 1x Yew reduce crown by up to 1.5m (height & spread).
decision_conditions: The tree is situated in the front garden of Ashleigh, The Green. The mature yew appears to be in a good condition, and has a well formed, natural crown that is characteristic of the species. It makes a positive contribution to both local biodiversity and the amenity value and arboreal character of the Harefield Village Conservation Area. The amenity and biodiversity benefits provided by the tree are both current and long-term, as the species is capable of achieving a considerable lifespan. Overall, the Yew has a moderate amenity value.

The proposed works have been refused on the grounds that no arboricultural reason has been provided, and the work would result in the unnecessary creation of multiple wounds within the crown increasing the risk of disease. Any resultant regrowth could be poorly attached and therefore more susceptible to future structural failure. The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.

Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981:  Note that it is an offence under this act to disturb roosting bats, nesting birds or any other protected species.  Therefore, if applicable, it is advisable to consult your tree surgeon / consultant to agree an acceptable time for carrying out the approved works.
Owner(s)'s permission:  Permission should be sought from the owner(s) of the tree(s) and / or the owner(s) of the land that the tree(s) overhang prior to any approved work being carried out.

Works to trees protected by Conservation Area: The Council has not made a Tree Preservation Order to protect the other trees outlined in your application and therefore you can proceed with the work specified in your application / notice. Under Section 211 (3) (b) (ii) of the Act, the work must be completed before the expiry of two years from the date of your application, after which a further notice of intent to carry out the work will be required.
